Entries.Name: Kweebec
Entries.Line: I sometimes see that French guy crawling around by those orange mushrooms. You know, the glowing polypores that grow on Kweebdrasil.

Entries.Name: Kweebec
Entries.Line: I don't know what he does there, and I'm not sure if I want to. One time, I saw him shirtless. Doing exercises and stuff while jumping around.

Line.Text: He never takes that beret off, though. I don't think that anyone has ever seen his leaves, even though Kweebecs are usually proud to show off our ancestry.
